title: Which club will sign Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Ezri Konsa is an England international defender playing for Aston Villa.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official club announcements or reputable sports reporting confirming a completed permanent transfer, rather than negotiations or transfer speculation. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the club that completes Konsa's permanent signing from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, by September 1, 2026. If multiple transfers occur, use his first permanent move away from Aston Villa in that window. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the signing club.
